Initial release — documentation-only skill for APIDot Meshy 6 3D API integration.

- Provides workflow and security best practices for Meshy 6 3D generation via APIDot.
- Covers text-to-3D, image-to-3D, multi-image-to-3D, async task flow, and webhook usage.
- No scripts, network requests, or stored credentials are included.
- Links to official APIDot docs, Meshy 6 model page, API references, and example repositories.
- Emphasizes secure API key handling and avoids copying unverified API facts or request fields.
